title: Australian Data Science Network Conference 2026
text:
Copyright JJ Harrison
Join us in the nation’s capital for the annual Australian Data Science Network Conference. This year’s theme is From Data to Decisions, which focuses on impactful data science that informs decisions, changes minds, and shapes policy.

title: Sponsorship
text:
https://www.abs.gov.au/





The Australian Bureau of Statistics are Australia’s national statistical agency and an official source of independent, reliable information. They are providing the perfect venue for this year’s conference, hosting us in the heart of the organisation at ABS House in Belconnen.








https://statsoc.org.au/





The Statistical Society of Australia is the peak professional body for statisticians and data scientists in Australia. With branches across the country and a data science special interest group, visit their website to find out how to join and what’s happening near you.

title: Destination
text:
ABS House is located at 45 Benjamin Way, Belconnen, Canberra, ACT 2617.
The conference will be held in the Knibbs Lecture Theatre.


The conference venue is a 10-minute drive from the CBD or a 20-minute drive from the Canberra Airport.
There are many car parks nearby, including at the Westfield Shopping Centre.





If you’re staying in the Canberra CBD area, you can catch routes 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 from Alinga Street to the Belconnen Bus Interchange. ABS House is just around the corner. To use public transport in Canberra you can simply tap on with a Visa or Mastercard card or use a MyWay+ card or the app.



E-bikes and e-scooters are available through Lime Micromobility, but we wouldn’t recommend scooting from the CBD!
